phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C3 — BPS/BOP External Sector Structure Audit
identity_results: S1 = S121 + S12T + S13 + S1P passes exactly for 2025-Q4 stock in EUR and RON and within published precision for 2025 annual flow.
S1P = S12M + S1V passes exactly for 2025-Q4 stock in EUR and RON.

The annual-flow S1P = S12M + S1V check has a residual of -0.202 million EUR / -1 million RON and therefore does not pass the preregistered 0.1-million tolerance; flow use requires a separate vintage/definition reconciliation.
S11 and S1M are unavailable for the probed Romania F2 series, so S1V cannot be split into non-financial corporations and households/NPISH.
S12M is published directly, so the non-central-bank RMD financial-sector external F2 candidate can be represented structurally as S12T + S12M without splitting S1P.
conceptual_boundary: BPS F2 is organised by BPM6 functional category. The probed series are Other Investment (O), while central-bank reserve assets are a separate Reserve Assets functional category.

Therefore BPS Other-Investment F2 totals are not presumed equal to QSA W1 F2 totals. Any later bridge for BNR must account explicitly for reserve-assets F2 rather than substituting one functional category for another.

Romania's Eurostat BOP metadata records BPM6-versus-ESA differences in the deposit/loan boundary for deposit-taking corporations; BPS F2 cannot enter the QSA Accounting Spine without a concept bridge.
Both EUR and RON versions are published for the coarse/intermediate structure, but they are not mixed; each unit is assessed independently.
blocker: The remaining H/C split is S1V = S11 + S1M. BPS does not publish S11 or S1M separately for the tested Romania F2 series, so exact H and C external F2 cannot be recovered from this BPS layer.

next_gate.name: Eurostat bop_iip6_q detailed-sector dissemination audit
next_gate.purpose: Test whether Eurostat's own quarterly BOP/IIP dissemination exposes S11 and household/NPISH detail for Romania F2 even where ECB BPS does not.
next_gate.rationale: Eurostat metadata states that financial-account/IIP data can be disseminated with financial corporations other than MFIs, non-financial corporations, and households/NPISH sector breakdowns, so this independent official dissemination layer should be tested before declaring the H/C split unavailable.
prohibited: splitting S1V or S1P by shares
using national financial-account domestic holdings as a proxy for external holdings
assuming Eurostat and ECB BPS vintages are identical without reconciliation
